report_name: Portsmouth City Council LOCAL CYCLING & WALKING INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN Background Report
how_pct_was_used: The PCT’s Government Target (Equality) scenario was used to identify the highest forecast future cycle commuting flows within the plan area.
quotes_on_using_pct: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT): a website analysis tool which forecasts the potential future growth of cycle trips under different scenarios for travel to work and travel to school.
